❓ Frequently asked questions

      
What is the Collatz conjecture?
That every positive integer reaches 1 by repeatedly halving evens and applying 3n+1 to odds — unproven but verified to huge bounds.
Why is 27 famous?
It takes 111 steps and climbs to 9,232 before falling to 1 — surprisingly wild for such a small start.
What does the chart show?
Each bar is a sequence value on a log scale, so both the huge spikes and the final descent stay visible.
